The company's business interests include [[automotive engineering]], [[embedded system]] and [[semiconductor]] engineering, [[industrial internet of things]], manufacturing plant engineering, and [[medical engineering]].{{cite news |title=Q4FY22 Investor Presentation |url=https://www.ltts.com/system/files/2022-08/Q4FY22-Investor-Presentation.pdf |access-date=8 January 2023 |work=LTTS}} LTTS is a subsidiary of the [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] [[Larsen & Toubro]] (L&T), and listed on both [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.businessworld.in/article/Corporate-On-The-Road-Less-Taken/03-02-2017-112394/|title=Corporate: On The Road Less Taken|last=Alvares|first=Clifford|date=2017-02-03|work=BW Businessworld|access-date=2017-09-26|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/811bf83f-ac5d-4761-8975-baf623f2ccb5.pdf|title=Financial Results FY25|last=|first=|date=2025-05-23|work=BSE|access-date=2025-05-23|pages=Page 6}} The company has offices across India, United States, Europe, and Asia.{{Cite news|url=https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/fedbank-finance-plans-to-open-30-more-branches-in-fy18/1065148|title=L&T Technology Services completes Esencia acquisition|date=2017-06-01|work=Outlook India|access-date=2017-09-26}} == History == L&T Technology Services (LTTS) was founded in 2006 as L&T Integrated Engineering Services. In its first year, the company generated $70 million in revenue. Initially, it only operated as the engineering arm of [[Larsen & Toubro]] and in 2013, as a result of L&T's strategy, the parent company was split into "nine [[Vertical integration|verticals]] and six subsidiaries", of which this was one.{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/lt-to-focus-on-engineering-services-with-new-entity/article5049383.ece|title=L&T to focus on engineering services with new entity|last=Shaker|first=S|date=2013-08-22|work=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=2017-09-26|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.fortuneindia.com/people/naiks-successor/100333|title=Naik's successor|last=Gupta|first=Ashish|date=2016-04-05|work=Fortune India|access-date=2017-09-26|language=en}} It began to expand its engineering services as a developer of corporate software under a new brand name L&T Technology Services (LTTS). In September 2016, LTTS had its initial public offering in the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]], making it the second L&T subsidiary to go public.{{Cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/lt-technology-ipo-subscribed-2-5-times/articleshow/54356710.cms|title=L&T Technology IPO subscribed 2.5 times|date=2016-09-16|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2017-09-26}}{{Cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/lt-technology-lists-at-rs-920-up-7-over-issue-price/articleshow/54475804.cms|title=L&T Technology lists at Rs 920, up 7% over issue price|last=Mudgill|first=Amit|date=2016-09-23|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2017-09-26}} [[A. M. Naik]], the current group chairman of the parent company, remained chairman of the subsidiary until his retirement in October 2017.{{Cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/western-protectionism-fears-more-media-hype-than-actual-a-m-naik/articleshow/60197282.cms|title=Western protectionism fears more media hype than actual: A M Naik|last=PTI|date=2017-08-23|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2017-09-26}} Keshab Panda was named as the CEO and managing director and [[S N Subrahmanyan|S.N.Subrahmanyan]] as vice chairman of the company.{{Cite news|url=http://businessworld.in/article/-What-I-Inherited-Is-Today-12-Of-L-T-The-Other-88-I-Have-Created-/20-09-2017-126603/|title='What I Inherited Is Today 12% Of L&T; The Other 88% I Have Created'|last=Alvares|first=Clifford|date=20 September 2017|work=BW Businessworld|access-date=2018-01-12|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=http://businessworld.in/article/L-T-The-Ambidextrous-Architect/20-09-2017-126609/|title=L&T: The Ambidextrous Architect|last=Alvares|first=Clifford|date=20 September 2017|work=BW Businessworld|access-date=2018-01-12|language=en}} In 2016, LTTS developed a set of personal safety gear that is based on [[Cloud computing|cloud]]-enabled technologies. L&T Technology Services (LTTS) is an Indian multinational technology company that provides engineering research and development (ER&D) services, headquartered in Vadodara. The company's business interests include automotive engineering, embedded system and semiconductor engineering, industrial internet of things, manufacturing plant engineering, and medical engineering.
LTTS is a subsidiary of the conglomerate Larsen & Toubro (L&T), and listed on both NSE and BSE. The company has offices across India, United States, Europe, and Asia.
